title: Volume packing bound for r-separated finite subsets of a bounded set in ℝⁿ
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let K ⊆ ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) be bounded. Then there is a constant C ∈ ℝ with the following property. For every r ∈ ℝ with 0 < r ≤ 1, and every finite set F ⊆ K that is r-separated (r < dist(x, y) for all distinct x, y ∈ F), card(F)·rⁿ ≤ C.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)), Bornology.IsBounded K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ∀ F : Finset (Rn n), (↑F : Set (Rn n)) ⊆ K → (∀ x ∈ F, ∀ y ∈ F, x ≠ y → r < dist x y) → (F.card : ℝ) * r ^ n ≤ C
